investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on a suspicious domain hosting a login page that asks for user credentials. The domain is only 25 days old, registered with NIC.xyz, and resolves to IP 45.138.27.112, a data center host. The logo matches the reference with high fidelity, but the domain is not Vitalis-controlled, suggesting potential brand impersonation and credential harvesting. Given the impersonation signals and the credential-login context, the alert is classified as High Priority.
